about: Experience Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
The Soulcalibur series is a weapon-based fighting game in which characters wage battle with a variety of unique weapons.

Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny features the original Gauntlet mode, where players go on an adventure with the characters of Soulcalibur while clearing various missions along the way. The missions are a great way to pick up battle knowledge, techniques, and improve your skills while having fun.
Of course, no Soulcalibur game would be complete without a guest appearance, and this time the special guest is none other than Kratos from the God of War series.
There is also a Character Creation
originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
feature, which allows players to create their own original characters with even more customizable parts and options than Soulcalibur IV.
"Chosen by history to be a warrior, then etched into history as a hero."
Transcending history and the world... enjoy this tale of souls and swords, eternally retold!

*This title has been converted from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
*Some game content may differ from the original PSP™ version.
*This game does not support multiplayer, and some Honors cannot be obtained.
summary: Experience Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
